messages:
Maya: Quick thread — int4 bring-up for redwood-v2.3-int4 on staging shadow. Ran 24h A/B vs int8, saw an odd longdoc rerank dip. Posting the smoke numbers and a proposed gating change.

Jorge: Paste of the window stats below. Not huge but consistent across the longdoc slice.

Jorge: ```
A/B window: 24h
Traffic: 10% canary (int4) vs 90% control (int8)
Sample size (longdoc slice): 18.2k requests
Longdoc MRR delta: -0.78% (95% CI [-1.24%, -0.32%], p=0.03)
Short QA MRR delta: +0.05% (ns)
Top-k rerank hit rate: -1.1% absolute on longdoc
Latency p95: +12ms (int4)
Errors: 0.02% (unchanged)
```

Lin: The CI and p-value make me think this is real for the longdoc slice. Could be quantization-induced reranker score shift on longer contexts (KV cache alignment?).

Sam: My proposal for canary gating: start canary at 5% traffic, run 30m checks every 15m. If any critical slice (longdoc, legal, codegen) shows >0.5% relative MRR regression with p<0.05 for 1h, auto-fallback. Otherwise ramp to 25% after 2h, then 50% after 6h with guardrails. Keep global tolerance at 0.25% delta for promotion to prod.

Maya: I like the multi-tier thresholds. Note: the longdoc slice is small-ish but high value. Sam — can we add a quiet-burn 2% traffic step for longdoc-heavy cohorts so we get denser signals?

Sam: Yes — add a "slice quiet-burn" rule: route 2% of longdoc-identified traffic to int4 for 4h before the broader 5% canary. That reduces noise on early detection.

Jorge: Also recommend an automated re-eval that diffs reranker logits for mismatched outputs; if top-1 rerank changes >0.8% on same prompt bucket, mark as "fidelity drift" and count towards fallback.

Lin: Agree. Add this to the rollback circuit: (a) longdoc MRR drop >0.5% & p<0.05 OR (b) top-1 rerank flip rate >0.8% for the slice over 1h -> trigger immediate rollback and alert to #eng-ml and oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for redwood-v2.3-int4 at 5% traffic. Health checks scheduled every 15m. Quiet-burn slice active for longdoc cohort (2%).

Maya: Running a targeted rerun with a larger longdoc sample and KV cache parity toggled to confirm. Will post updated numbers in 2-3h.

(2h later)

deploy-bot: Auto-fallback triggered at 6321012000 (UTC) — reason: longdoc MRR delta crossed -0.9% over 30m with p=0.02 and top-1 rerank flips 1.2% > threshold. Canary traffic scaled down and previous version re-promoted.

Jorge: Thanks — that matches the hypothesis. Can we capture the exact sample ids for tracing? Also export the reranker logits snapshot.

Maya: Captured and stored in s3://redwood-eval/rollouts/6321009999/ — I'll attach the eval notebook. Next steps: run narrow int8 vs quantization-variant experiments (per-layer scale tweaks) and re-run the quiet-burn after fixes.

Lin: Action items: 1) Jorge to add rerank-flip detector to the canary checks (PR queued). 2) Sam to codify quiet-burn steps in the rollout config. 3) Maya to run expanded longdoc re-eval and KV parity test. 4) Deploy-bot will keep auto-fallback rule live for next 3 rollouts.

Sam: Also propose we lower the promotion global tolerance from 0.25% -> 0.2% for the next month while we iterate on quant stability.

Maya: Agreed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
